summary: Nu Holdings Ltd., a foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K reporting its second quarter 2026 financial results. The filing includes operating and financial highlights such as customer growth to 139 million, revenue of nearly $5.9 billion, and net income of $1.1 billion. No special-situation transaction or event is described; the 6-K is a routine earnings release. The company mentions business expansions but no M&A, tender offer, or strategic review. The filing is an ordinary current report of financial results, not a special situation.
